source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Scanned school paper (no text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark). Printed header: FINAL EXAMINATION, Std. 7, Date: 18/02/2025, Sub: Biology, Time: 1 ½ hr., Marks: 60 (durationMinutes 90 as printed). The paper prints Std. 7 although icseboard.org lists it under class 8, so the pack is filed under class 7 (key changed from icse-school-8-… to icse-school-7-…). examYear 2025 from the printed date. All questions are compulsory; Section A (30 marks) is Q.I-Q.V and Section B (30 marks) is Q.VI-Q.X; the pack total equals the 60-mark maximum. Groups with only one printed group mark (Q.I (10), Q.III, Q.IV, Q.V, Q.VI, Q.VII, Q.IX, Q.X) are kept as one entry each; Q.II (5 × 1 = 5) and Q.VIII (5 × 2 = 10) are split per item. Student ticks on the MCQ options and handwritten T/F marks in Q.III were ignored. No school name printed. No answer key.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
